Title: Prompt Engineer
Location: Mumbai
Exp: 2+ Years


Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Prompt Engineer to design, test, and optimize AI-powered solutions
using Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate is exceptionally strong at prompting and
has hands-on experience with API integrations. Knowledge of Python and AI/ML concepts is
preferred.
You will collaborate with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Product Teams, and Business Stakeholders
to build scalable LLM applications, intelligent agents, and enterprise copilots.
Key Responsibilities
Design, test, and optimize prompts for LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral.
Develop reusable prompt templates, prompt libraries, and evaluation workflows.
Apply advanced prompting techniques, including zero-shot, few-shot, Chain-of-Thought (CoT),
ReAct, self-reflection, and Tree of Thoughts.
Evaluate prompt quality using quantitative and qualitative metrics.
Build context-aware AI workflows with secure tool invocation and context management.
Integrate LLM APIs, including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini.
Build AI applications, automation scripts, backend services, and evaluation pipelines using
Python.
Support AI agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling, function calling, conversational AI, and
enterprise copilots.
Help optimize AI application performance, reliability, and cost.
Required Skills
Very strong prompt-engineering skills with practical experience designing, testing, and improving
LLM prompts.
Experience with API integrations, including REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, and LLM APIs.
Strong understanding of advanced prompting techniques such as zero-shot, few-shot, CoT,
ReAct, self-reflection, and Tree of Thoughts.
Familiarity with agentic AI, tool calling, function calling, and multi-agent systems.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Skills
Good working knowledge of Python for AI applications, automation, backend services, or
evaluation pipelines.
Understanding of AI/ML concepts, including NLP, transformer architecture, embeddings, vector
databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Familiarity with evaluating or fine-tuning foundation models.
Exposure to OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar LLM platforms.
Qualifications
0 3 years of relevant experience in prompt engineering, LLM applications, AI/ML, software
development, or related areas.
Demonstrable strength in prompting and practical experience with API integrations.
Python and AI/ML knowledge are preferred.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Data Scientists, AI Engineers,
Product Teams, and Business Stakeholders

",
